summary.en: Xiaomi's AI platform providing large language models and voice assistant capabilities.
summary.zh: 小米的AI平台，提供大语言模型和语音助手功能。

title.en: Xiaomi AI API Key - Large Language Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: 小米AI API Key - 大语言模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Xiaomi AI API key for access to their large language models and voice assistant capabilities.
description.zh: 获取小米AI API Key，访问其大语言模型和语音助手功能。

en: Xiaomi AI capabilities are exposed mainly through Xiaomi’s open platform (open.mi.com), which is broader than a single “LLM API key” console.
Depending on the product, you may work with open-platform apps, voice/assistant integrations, or other AI-related services—not only a chat completions endpoint.
getModelKey links the official open.mi.com entry. We do not sell Xiaomi credentials or API keys.
zh: 小米 AI 相关能力主要经由小米开放平台（open.mi.com）对外提供，形态往往比单一「大模型 API Key 控制台」更广。
按具体产品不同，可能涉及开放平台应用、语音/助手接入或其他 AI 服务，而不只是聊天补全接口。
getModelKey 链接至 open.mi.com 官方入口，不出售小米凭证或 API Key。

en: Go to open.mi.com, register or sign in as a Xiaomi Open Platform developer.
Create or select an application/project for the Xiaomi AI or related capability you need.
Generate credentials (AppId, keys, or tokens) as shown in that product’s open-platform docs—not all products use a single “API key” field.
Configure callbacks and permissions per the docs, and keep secrets only on trusted servers.
zh: 访问 open.mi.com，注册或登录小米开放平台开发者账号。
为所需的小米 AI 或相关能力创建/选择应用或项目。
按该产品开放文档生成凭证（AppId、密钥或 Token 等；并非所有产品都只有单一 API Key 字段）。
按文档配置回调与权限，密钥仅保存在可信服务端。

question.en: Is open.mi.com only for LLM API keys?
question.zh: open.mi.com 只提供大模型 API Key 吗？

answer.en: No. It is Xiaomi’s broader open platform. AI LLM access may be one of several product paths—check the docs for the service you need.
answer.zh: 不是。它是更广义的小米开放平台。大模型只是可能路径之一，请按目标服务查阅对应文档。

question.en: Does getModelKey issue Xiaomi AI keys?
question.zh: getModelKey 会发放小米 AI 密钥吗？

answer.en: No. We only link official pages. All credentials are created inside Xiaomi’s open platform.
answer.zh: 不会。我们只链接官方页面；所有凭证需在小米开放平台内创建。

question.en: Where do I confirm which AI APIs are available?
question.zh: 如何确认有哪些 AI 接口可用？

answer.en: Use open.mi.com documentation and product listings. Availability and naming can change; treat official docs as source of truth.
answer.zh: 以 open.mi.com 文档与产品目录为准。可用性与命名会变化，请以官方文档为唯一依据。
